aiReviewer: OpenAI GPT-6, AI editorial review (not independent human review)
reviewNotes: Editorial review for 20 B1/B2 adjective seeds, 40 original selection-format exercises, with context-specific choices and bilingual feedback. Every question checked independently for meaning, natural German, exact adjective forms, competing answers among options, hint leakage, rubric/answer completeness and distinct contexts. Two rare emphatic stems allerbest-/allerschönst- are explicitly contrasted with ordinary superlatives; original source sentences not copied. Level classification remains inherited and provisional. Structural validation via GitHub Actions is required and not claimed locally. No learner evidence, content release, human editorial approval, API usage or deployment.
